<!-- Adding mods/<id>.toml by hand? Read the mod policy first; the file itself goes to the `staging` prerelease
     as <sha256>.<extension>, which a reviewer uploads. -->

**Project:** <!-- id, and new project or update -->

- [ ] I made it, or I am allowed to publish it, under the licence the entry names.
- [ ] If it ports or translates another mod, the original's licence allows it (or its authors agreed), and my page
      credits and links the original.
- [ ] It has no code, assets or data from Minecraft, Mojang or Microsoft, and nothing that harms players.
- [ ] I read and accept the [mod policy](https://github.com/curse-rusts/curse-mods/blob/main/MOD-POLICY.md): I am this
      project's author or publisher and responsible for it; the Curse project is not.
- [ ] The `source` link has the code this file was built from.
- [ ] I ran the registry's file check on it (`cargo curse-mod check <file>`) and it passed.

The file goes in the `staging` release as `<sha256>.<extension>`; ask a reviewer to upload it.
